title: Range of a quadratic function that opens up

section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Analyzing Graphs of Quadratic Functions

sources: Example recipe in the plugin's tests (format 2); Bittinger 7e §3.3

steps.name: decide whether the parabola opens up or down
steps.show: a = {a} > 0: opens up, so {k} is the minimum

steps.name: write the range in interval notation

mistakes.name: used ( at the minimum
mistakes.message: The minimum value is reached, so it is included: use [.

mistakes.name: used the x-coordinate
mistakes.message: The range is about y-values: use the y-coordinate of the vertex.

hints.why: The vertex holds the lowest y-value.

hints.step: decide whether the parabola opens up or down
hints.hint: Look at the sign of a.
hints.why: Up means the vertex is a minimum.

hints.step: write the range in interval notation
hints.hint: From the minimum up to infinity.
hints.why: Every y-value at or above the minimum is reached.
